points.K6: 进去的人要清楚在做什么

points.K9: 光从柜里经反射镜到切割头

points.K12: 开盖出光：看不见，会起火

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一条黄黑链条旁，身后是激光切割机
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands next to a yellow and black barrier chain with a laser cutting machine behind it.
shots.narration: 这一课：看懂激光车间的警示。
overlay: 看懂激光警示：标志、贴纸和链条

shots.scene: 激光警告标志、黄色贴纸、链条三个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a laser warning sign, a small yellow sticker, and a barrier chain. No people.
shots.narration: 标志、贴纸、链条，都在说话。

shots.scene: 阿杰参观时想抄近路，伸手要跨过机器背面的链条
shots.prompt_en: During a visit, the young male student wants a shortcut and reaches to step over the chain behind the laser machine.
shots.narration: 阿杰想抄近路，要跨过链条。

shots.scene: 老李在后面喊住他，阿杰停下回头
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer calls out from behind, and the young male student stops and turns around.
shots.narration: 老李喊住他：这链条可不是摆设！

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前歪头思考
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot tilts its head thoughtfully in front of a blank whiteboard.
shots.narration: 链条后面有什么？我们去看看。

shots.section_title: 访客不熟悉车间，要照看
shots.scene: 老李在实验室门口迎接参观的同学
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer welcomes visiting students at the door of a laser processing lab.
shots.narration: 来参观的人都想看激光。
overlay: 访客不熟悉车间，要照看

shots.section_title: 访客不熟悉车间，要照看
shots.scene: 家、办公室和车间三个图标，车间图标带感叹号
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a home, an office, and a workshop, with an exclamation mark over the workshop. No people.
shots.narration: 他们熟悉家和办公室，不熟悉车间。

shots.section_title: 访客不熟悉车间，要照看
shots.scene: 老李走在队伍旁，伸手示意大家靠拢
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer walks beside the visitors, gesturing for them to stay close together.
shots.narration: 所以带人进来，要处处照看。

shots.scene: 机器正面铺着黑色安全地垫
shots.prompt_en: A black safety floor mat along the front of the laser cutting machine. No people.
shots.narration: 机器正面有安全地垫，一踩就停。

shots.scene: 机器背面的通道，地上什么也没有
shots.prompt_en: The walkway behind the laser machine with a bare floor and no mat. No people.
shots.narration: 可背面没有这样的装置。

shots.scene: 背面通道口拉着一条黄黑相间的链条
shots.prompt_en: A yellow and black chain stretched across the entrance of the rear walkway. No people.
shots.narration: 背面就用链条拦住。

shots.scene: 链条像一根拉绳，挡住一个人形图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of the chain acting like a safety cord, blocking a person icon. No people.
shots.narration: 它像一道拉绳，把人挡在外面。

shots.scene: 链条图标和停机图标之间画着不等号
shots.prompt_en: A chain icon and a machine stop icon with a not-equal sign between them. No people.
shots.narration: 但链条不会让机器停，只能提醒。

shots.section_title: 背面是维修人员的地方
shots.scene: 老李戴着防护眼镜在机器背面检修
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer, wearing laser safety goggles, does maintenance work behind the machine.
shots.narration: 背面通常只有维修人员进来。
overlay: 背面是维修人员的地方

shots.section_title: 背面是维修人员的地方
shots.scene: 老李在反射镜座旁做光路校准
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer works on a mirror mount during beam alignment with the laser switched off.
shots.narration: 他们在这里校准光路。

shots.section_title: 防被龙门架和风琴管缠住
shots.scene: 背面导轨上，龙门架带着风琴管来回滑动
shots.prompt_en: Behind the machine, the gantry slides back and forth along a rail with a folding bellows cover. No people.
shots.narration: 龙门架在导轨上来回滑动。
overlay: 防被龙门架和风琴管缠住

shots.section_title: 防被龙门架和风琴管缠住
shots.scene: 衣角被风琴管卷住的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a shirt hem caught in a moving bellows, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 人走进去，容易被卷住、撞到。

shots.section_title: 进去的人要清楚在做什么
shots.scene: 背面的检修面板和气管接口
shots.prompt_en: Service panels and air connections on the back of the machine. No people.
shots.narration: 检修面板、气路，维护时才进。
overlay: 进去的人要清楚在做什么

shots.section_title: 进去的人要清楚在做什么
shots.scene: 老李停机后，取下链条走进去
shots.prompt_en: After the machine is stopped, the facility engineer unhooks the chain and steps in.
shots.narration: 进去的人，必须清楚自己在做什么。

shots.section_title: 进去的人要清楚在做什么
shots.scene: 一个人懵懂走进链条内的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person wandering past the chain without noticing, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不能稀里糊涂走进去受了伤。

shots.scene: 链条挂起，旁边一个禁止入内标志
shots.prompt_en: The chain hangs across the walkway with a no entry sign beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 链条挂着，就是不得进入。

shots.scene: 阿杰点点头，退回到链条外
shots.prompt_en: The young male student nods and steps back outside the chain.
shots.narration: 阿杰退了回来。

shots.section_title: 光路上到处是黄色警示贴
shots.scene: 光路护管和反射镜座上贴着一张张黄色警示贴
shots.prompt_en: Several small yellow warning stickers on the beam tubes and mirror mounts. No people.
shots.narration: 背面光路上，贴满了黄色警示贴。
overlay: 光路上到处是黄色警示贴

shots.section_title: 光从柜里经反射镜到切割头
shots.scene: 示意图：激光柜发出光束，经几面反射镜转到切割头
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: a beam leaves the laser cabinet, bounces off several mirrors, and travels to the cutting head. No people.
shots.narration: 激光在柜里产生，靠反射镜转弯。
overlay: 光从柜里经反射镜到切割头

shots.section_title: 光从柜里经反射镜到切割头
shots.scene: 光束经过反射镜后变得整齐，射进切割头
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: mirrors shape and steer the beam neatly down into the cutting head. No people.
shots.narration: 一路整形、转向，送到切割头。

shots.section_title: 贴纸的意思：后面可能有激光
shots.scene: 一张黄色警示贴特写，下面是护罩
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a yellow warning sticker on a metal beam cover. No people.
shots.narration: 每张贴纸都在说一句话：
overlay: 贴纸的意思：后面可能有激光

shots.section_title: 贴纸的意思：后面可能有激光
shots.scene: 揭开护罩的图标，后面露出一道光束
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a beam cover being lifted, revealing a beam behind it. No people.
shots.narration: 揭开这里，后面可能就有激光。

shots.section_title: 维修人员按规程开护罩
shots.scene: 老李确认激光关闭后，取下护罩检查反射镜
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer confirms the laser is off, then removes a cover and inspects a mirror.
shots.narration: 维修人员先确认不出光，再开护罩。
overlay: 维修人员按规程开护罩

shots.section_title: 维修人员按规程开护罩
shots.scene: 老李在镜座上放一个空白靶片对中
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer places a blank alignment target on the mirror mount.
shots.narration: 检查镜片，用靶片对中光路。

shots.section_title: 维修人员按规程开护罩
shots.scene: 非维修人员伸手揭护罩的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an untrained person removing a beam cover, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不是维修人员，护罩一律不碰。

shots.section_title: 开盖出光：看不见，会起火
shots.scene: 一束看不见的光用虚线表示，眼睛图标打问号
shots.prompt_en: An invisible beam shown only as a dotted line, with an eye icon and a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 开着激光揭护罩，光会射出来。
overlay: 开盖出光：看不见，会起火

shots.section_title: 开盖出光：看不见，会起火
shots.scene: 虚线光束看不见，旁边写着红外的图标
shots.prompt_en: A dotted beam next to an infrared wave icon. No people.
shots.narration: 它是红外光，你根本看不见。

shots.section_title: 开盖出光：看不见，会起火
shots.scene: 虚线光束打到纸箱上，纸箱冒烟起火
shots.prompt_en: The dotted invisible beam hits a cardboard box, which starts to smoke and catch fire. No people.
shots.narration: 射到哪里，哪里就可能起火。

shots.scene: 一张被纸箱挡住的激光警告标志
shots.prompt_en: A laser warning sign partly hidden behind stacked boxes. No people.
shots.narration: 警示标志被挡住，就等于没有。

shots.scene: 一张褪色卷边的警示贴，旁边是新贴的标志
shots.prompt_en: A faded, peeling warning sticker next to a fresh new laser warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 褪色、脱落、看不清，都要更换。

shots.scene: 阿杰拍照后给老李打电话报告
shots.prompt_en: The young male student takes a photo of a damaged sign and calls the facility engineer to report it.
shots.narration: 发现了就报告，不要自己撕贴。

shots.scene: 激光实验室门口，门上方警示灯亮起，门上有激光警告标志
shots.prompt_en: A laser lab door with a laser warning sign and a glowing warning light above it. No people.
shots.narration: 门口警示灯亮，说明里面在出光。

shots.scene: 小研在门外停下，按门铃等候
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stops outside the door and presses the doorbell to wait.
shots.narration: 没授权不进，有事先联系里面的人。

shots.scene: 示意图：光束末端打在一块挡板上被吸收
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: the end of a beam path hits a beam stop block and is absorbed. No people.
shots.narration: 光束走到头，要有挡板接住。

shots.scene: 光束射向通道和纸箱的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a beam pointing toward a walkway and a cardboard box, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不能让光束射向通道和可燃物。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现链条、禁止入内标志、黄色贴纸三个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside three icons: a barrier chain, a no entry sign, and a yellow warning sticker.
shots.narration: 链条挂着不进，贴纸后面有激光。

shots.scene: 虚线光束、火苗和挡板三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a dotted invisible beam, a small flame, and a beam stop block. No people.
shots.narration: 红外光看不见，终点要挡住。

shots.scene: 警示灯和更换标志的图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a glowing door warning light and a replaced warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 灯亮不进，标志坏了就报修。

shots.scene: 欣欣和阿杰、老李、小研在链条外挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye with the young male student, the facility engineer and the female graduate student outside the barrier chain.
shots.narration: 看懂警示，听从警示。
